2.  **Floating Panels:** **Not visible in this view.** The screenshot cuts off after the hero section/globe. I cannot confirm if the 4 panels are stacked as cards below the fold.
3.  **Layout Breakage:** **No.** There is no horizontal overflow or squashed elements visible. Padding looks consistent, and text wraps correctly within the container.
